title: kb-sprint review names the headless reviewer's launch: cwd, scratch dir, --max-turns, stdin brief, read-only
goal: Found in the SP-d3hybrlv review: review step 4 starts the fresh-context reviewer as a headless session 'as run step 3 starts a worker', but run step 3's fixed brief parts are by item kind, so the reviewer has no --max-turns, no named cwd (the intake hook may leave drafts in the main clone), no scratch dir and no read-only rule. SKILL.md review step 4 and backlog.md name them.

run: import sys;t=open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();r=t.split('## review SP')[1].split('## close SP')[0];ok='--max-turns' in r and 'read-only' in r;print('reviewer launch:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
